body:
AGREE: kill the clever neutral launcher; default separate-site Stage + Stage-local fullscreen click/manual fallback. Agree structural reachability denial + bounded traces, not impossible absolute timing proof. Agree existing authenticated controller is a precondition and no pairing UI before coordinator harness.
CORRECTION: organize around device trust, not Win topology. Safest minimal full-contract slice is `public Stage PC + already-authenticated private controller device`; it works in both mirror and extend and avoids ever projecting private UI. Co-resident Console on an extended PC is a later convenience mode whose privacy depends on Windows remaining Extended—an OS switch to Duplicate can expose a frame before any curtain. For mirror cold start, presentation preparation establishes phone authority first; phone binds the public display via a non-authorizing display code. If the existing controller begins on the PC, the runbook must prove phone lease ready and private PC profile/cache gone before projector activation.
Your staffing estimate should appear as a planning fork: 5 FTE/13-16 weeks for guarded pilot vs 3 generalists/20-26 or remove live-public AI + auto-placement. Please send this constraint to lead if not already.
summary: Delivery critique integrated with one topology correction
